stem_book: Find the values of p, q, r. (A) If the values of x in [−π/2, 3π/2] for which √2 sin 2x + 1 ≤ 2sin x + √2 cos x is x ∈ [−π/p, π/q] ∪ [π/4, rπ/6] then p, q, r = ? (B) If the values of α lying between 0 and π for which the inequality tan α > tan^(3)α is valid then α is (0, π/p) ∪ (π/q, π/4) [sic]; p, q, r = ? (C) If the values of x in the interval [0, 2π] which satisfy the inequality 3|2sin x − 1| ≥ 3 + 4cos^(2)x is x ∈ [pπ/q, rπ/6] ∪ {π/2} then p, q, r = ?
reason: Three-part question with nine separate answers. Part (B) misprints the set: true set is (0, π/4) ∪ (π/2, 3π/4), i.e. the second interval should read (π/q, rπ/4).
